name: November.
source: ――Non vem ber―― These were the mysterious words that a little girl who has never been “outside”, heard in her dreams. The next day, the doctor tells her that she will be going outside of this facility. However, the "Outside World" that she was thrown into was a high-rise area that has gone to ruin... Why was the little girl sent "outside"? Exactly "where" is this world that has turned into "ruin"? And what do the words she heard in the dream mean? As she is tossed around between the people who want to protect her and the people who want to take her away, the little girl begins to learn to stand on her own two feet.
translation: ——Non vem ber——從未到過「外面」的小女孩，在夢中聽見了這幾個神秘的音節。第二天，醫師告訴她，她即將離開這座設施。然而，等待著她的「外面的世界」，竟是一片高樓林立的廢墟……為什麼小女孩會被送到「外面」？這個化為「廢墟」的世界，究竟是「哪裡」？夢中聽見的話，又是什麼意思？有人想保護她，有人想帶走她，在雙方之間身不由己的小女孩，開始學會獨立前行。
